Shaped Thursday Show me a shape you found out in the world - a heart worn into a leaf, a perfect circle, a triangle hiding in the shadows. Any shape counts, as long as it stopped you. Mine is this fallen leaf: a little heart-shaped hole, worn right through. One photo per reply, please. Pattern Tuesday favorites 🏆 5 patterns that stopped my scroll: Craig Jackson Images @craigjacksonimages - frost-rimmed red leaf Jan Kolby @badegghunter - tire tread in sand Erika @erikartistry - glitter droplet, peacock feather Lucille Pippetti @lucillepippetti - white-dotted haworthia rosette Rob Major @robmajor111 - Oculus white ribs Beautiful work, all of you. The reel is on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reel/Df4DOrQDyOm/

No reply images.

Pattern Tuesday This week, get close. Show me a pattern hiding in the details - needles on a branch, bark, petals, brickwork. If it repeats, it counts. Mine: a blue spruce branch, silver needles fanning out in every direction. One photo per reply, please. Replying is consent: • Top 5 featured tomorrow on Threads, pinned • Top 3 also in the Instagram reel • Full credit to the author everywhere • Standouts may join a best-of-the-week reel What pattern is hiding in your camera roll?
